SELECT DISTINCT store_id, store_name, city
FROM dim_store
WHERE city = 'Tampere' AND is_current = true
ORDER BY store_id

calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS member_count
FROM dim_member
WHERE home_store_id IN (115, 116, 117, 136)
  AND is_current = true

-- Verify: breakdown by store
SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS member_count
FROM dim_member m
JOIN dim_store s ON m.home_store_id = s.store_id
WHERE s.city = 'Tampere'
  AND s.store_id NOT IN (900, 999)
  AND m.is_current = true
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
ORDER BY s.store_id
